crossRefs.note: You were bought with a price. Don’t become bondservants of men.
Take heed, therefore, to yourselves, and to all the flock, in which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd…
Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who…
nor yet through the blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once for all into the Holy Place…
knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed…
But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in…
They sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals: for you were killed, and bought…
Whether therefore you eat, or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.
Even so, let your light shine before men; that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father who is in heaven.
I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh, for as you presented your members as servants to…
Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to…
according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always…
But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim…

translations.web: for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.
translations.bsb: you were bought at a price. Therefore glorify God with your body.
translations.kjv: For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God's.
translations.asv: for ye were bought with a price: glorify God therefore in your body.
